title: Elite tennis ensemble analysis: reproducible set-level workflow
description:
Version 1.0.2 accompanies the revised manuscript and contains the author-supplied source workbooks, processed inputs, predictions, explanations, supplementary tables, figure exports and numerical reproduction scripts.

Revision analyses include twelve-indicator outcome exclusion, random and member-count-matched ensemble comparisons, opponent-rank adjustment, alternative return representations and two-observer recoding checks. See RELEASE_NOTES.md and LICENSE for details.
notes: Author-owned materials use CC BY 4.0. Identified third-party source-derived records retain attribution and CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 as specified in LICENSE and data/README.md.
